name: Yang Bay
kicker: The forest waterfall and the lake
summary: Forest waterfall inland: walk the falls and the lake on a day about 38 to 40 km from the city. The general ticket is 120,000 VND. A mineral-bath combo is 250,000 VND, and the mud-bath combo is 390,000 VND. Give the park a day away from the sand.
dotReason: A full inland day for the falls, with a mud-bath combo on the top ticket, separate from the beach.
getThere: About 38 to 40 km from the centre, in Khánh Vĩnh.
heroCaption: The stepped falls and the pool at Yang Bay

notice.title: The mud bath is the top ticket
notice.body: The general gate is 120,000 VND. The mineral bath is the 250,000 VND combo. The mud bath is the 390,000 VND combo. A second provincial page leaves the price out.

body: Yang Bay is the waterfall park inland from the beach. One provincial page puts it about 38 km from the centre, at Khánh Phú in Khánh Vĩnh. The falls are low and sit on a lake. Walk Yang Bay 1, Yang Bay 2, Hố Cho, and Yang Khang. The other provincial page says about 40 km and gives the Raglai name as heavenly waterfall.

The priced page lists three tickets: 120,000 VND general, 250,000 VND with the mineral bath, and 390,000 VND with the mineral bath and the mud bath. Buy the top ticket if the mud is the reason you came. The same page also names the Khánh Sơn lithophone. The second page names a Raglai stage with gongs and the lithophone, and a flower field of more than 10,000 m², and it also describes a night in a tent.

figures.caption: The lake shore and the path beside the water
figures.alt: A rocky path along the green water at Yang Bay

gettingThere: The priced page gives Khánh Phú, Khánh Vĩnh, about 38 km from the city centre. The other provincial page says about 40 km and lists 77 Yersin, Nha Trang. Use the Khánh Vĩnh address for the forest park. The Yersin line is a city street.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Inland to Khánh Phú, Khánh Vĩnh. The two provincial distances are about 38 km and about 40 km.

legs.heading: From the centre
legs.body: Same inland ride. Plan the day around the falls, and add the mud bath only on the 390,000 VND ticket.

admissionNote: 120,000 VND general, 250,000 VND with the mineral bath, and 390,000 VND with the mineral bath and the mud bath, on the provincial page that lists prices. A second provincial page leaves the price out. The 77 Yersin address is on that second page.
